mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.25% signals an accommodative monetary policy environment that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 9.5% indicates a weak labor market that prompts the Federal Reserve to maintain low interest rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods when UNRATE > 9.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in the labor market (PAYEMS above 129000) and low unemployment (UNRATE below 5.5%) signals an overheating economy that triggers expectations of Federal Reserve tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 0.25%), the Federal Reserve's policy shift toward higher interest rates compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.25%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Robust retail sales (RSAFS) above 350,000 indicate strong consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods when RSAFS > 350000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high retail sales (RSAFS > 350000) and strong industrial production (INDPRO > 100.5) indicate an overheating economy that triggers Federal Reserve tightening expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the late-cycle expansion regime (defined by UNRATE < 5.0 and PAYEMS > 129000), the S&P 500 tends to produce negative 20-day forward returns as the market prices in an impending Federal Reserve tightening due to economic overheating.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in the late-cycle expansion regime, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
